summary: The only original (s000) FDA review document in paperclip, the Summary Review (Division Director / Cross Discipline Team Leader memo), reports that romiplostim was discussed at a March 12, 2008 Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee, where the committee unanimously regarded the safety and efficacy data as persuasive of a favorable risk:benefit. The review documents describe no specific advisory-committee concern tied to a resulting change; the safety-driven measures (REMS/NEXUS program, labeling, and post-marketing requirements for myelofibrosis, antibody, pregnancy, and MDS/neoplasia risks) are attributed to the FDA review team's own safety findings rather than to the AdComm, so no concern-to-change linkage is supported by the text.
